policy.notes: Repository metadata and README blob SHAs are discovery evidence only; they do not prove runtime maturity, security, compatibility or qualification.
policy.control_plane: MediaHub remains the sole control plane and MediaHub Product State Authority remains authoritative.
policy.provider_route: No unauthorized paid fallback; provider/model allowlists and budget gates must remain explicit.
policy.agent_dispatch: Gemini only through approved controller after Issue #301 gates.
policy.source_pin_caveat: Wave 434 uses immutable commit IDs returned by repository-scoped GitHub commit search; exact refs/heads/<default-branch> pointer equivalence is not independently exposed/verified by the connected GitHub tools.
policy.license_gate: LiteLLM and Langfuse root LICENSE files contain path/subtree licensing exceptions; remain CONDITIONAL until every proposed reused path's license is audited.
policy.comparison_order: Do not start formal scoring or component assembly until candidate coverage, source pins, licensing, dependency/advisory, CI, and maturity gates are closed.
